description: Áreas en condición de amenaza por movimiento en masa para suelo rural. POT Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. En el marco del Decreto 555 de 2021 "Plan de Ordenamiento Territorial de Bogotá D.C". Condición de Amenaza por movimiento en masa en suelo rural. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Planeación - SDP. Its tags are Amenazas, Determinantes Ambientales, Estructura Ecológica Principal, Medio Ambiente, Mitigación. It offers 6 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2024-11-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
